_comment: Message table for the family-customization profile card on the settings hub (programme room
طابع العائلة, slice 2). Applied once with:
Arabic is the template language; English is the fallback. Every value is written for a parent,
never for an engineer, and no value carries a digit a family might want written their way —
those come from the app's own numeral reader at runtime.
Day names are NOT here on purpose: the app already owns seven of them (screenTimeServerDay*)
and a second set would be two truths about what Friday is called.
Keep this file after applying: it is the reviewable record of what was added and why.

messages.en: Your family's character
messages.desc: Settings hub — the card that holds a family's own week, rest days, addressing words and digits.

messages.ar: أسبوعكم، أيام راحتكم، كلمات أبنائكم، وأرقامكم. ما تختارونه هنا تقرأه الشاشات كلها.
messages.en: Your week, your rest days, the words your children use, and your digits. Every screen reads what you choose here.
messages.desc: Says what the card changes, so a parent knows it is a setting and not a summary.

messages.en: Which day your week starts on
messages.desc: The family's own first day of the week.

messages.en: Rest days
messages.desc: Which days this family rests on.

messages.ar: يوم واحد على الأقل — كل حسابٍ في التطبيق يقيس أسبوعه عليها.
messages.en: At least one day — every count in the app measures its week against these.
messages.desc: Why an empty rest list is not offered, stated as a fact rather than a scold.

messages.en: Your digits
messages.desc: How this family wants numbers written.

messages.en: Western digits
messages.desc: The choice the app has always drawn. No digits in the value: the shape is shown by the preview line.

messages.en: Eastern digits
messages.desc: The choice a family may now take. No digits in the value — see the Western label's note.

messages.en: This is how your numbers look: {sample}
messages.desc: Live preview of the family's own digits, rendered by the app's numeral reader.

messages.en: What your children call their family
messages.desc: The four addressing words this family chooses.

messages.ar: كلمة واحدة قصيرة لكل دور. اتركوا الحقل فارغاً ليعود كما كان في التطبيق.
messages.en: One short word for each role. Leave a field empty to return it to the app's own word.
messages.desc: Explains both the limit and how to undo a word, in one line.

messages.en: What children call their father
messages.desc: Label for the father's addressing word.

messages.en: What children call their mother
messages.desc: Label for the mother's addressing word.

messages.en: What children call their other guardian
messages.desc: Label for the added guardian's addressing word.

messages.en: How a child's card is addressed
messages.desc: Label for the word a child's row is shown with.

messages.ar: لم تُغيّروا شيئاً بعد — هذا ما يبدأ به التطبيق لكل عائلة.
messages.en: Nothing has been changed yet — this is where every family starts.
messages.desc: Shown when the family has no stored profile, so a default is never read as a decision.

messages.en: Save your family's character
messages.desc: The card's only write action.

messages.ar: حُفظ اختياركم، وهو ما تقرأه الشاشات الآن.
messages.en: Your choice is saved, and it is what the screens read now.
messages.desc: Confirmation that the change reached the family's record.

messages.en: Read it again
messages.desc: Retry when there was nothing to show.

messages.ar: لا عائلة متصلة على هذا الجهاز، فلم نسأل أحداً عن طابعكم.
messages.en: No family is connected on this device, so nobody was asked about your character.
messages.desc: Honest state: nothing was read because there was nobody to ask.

messages.ar: لم يُجب أحد. ما ترونه آخرُ ما قرأناه، وليس تأكيداً من الآن.
messages.en: Nobody answered. What you see is the last thing we read, not a confirmation from now.
messages.desc: Honest state: the connection did not answer.

messages.ar: حسابك لا يطّلع على طابع هذه العائلة من هنا.
messages.en: Your account does not open this family's character from here.
messages.desc: The family said this account may not read its profile.

messages.ar: جاءنا جوابٌ لم نفهمه، ولم نخمّن بدله.
messages.en: An answer arrived that we could not read, and we did not guess at one.
messages.desc: A malformed reply is reported as a defect, never as an empty profile.

messages.ar: غيّر أحدكم الطابع بعد أن فتحتموه. أعدنا لكم أحدث ما عند العائلة — راجعوه ثم احفظوا إن شئتم.
messages.en: Someone in your family changed this after you opened it. We brought back their version — check it, then save if you still want to.
messages.desc: A version conflict, stated as what happened and what to do next.

messages.ar: تعديل الطابع لصاحب العائلة أولاً؛ ما ترونه هنا قراءةٌ فقط.
messages.en: Only the family's first guardian changes this. What you see here is a read.
messages.desc: The write was refused because the profile is read by every system in the app.

messages.ar: لا يُترك أسبوعٌ بلا يوم راحة.
messages.en: A week is never left without a rest day.
messages.desc: The floor, said the same way whether it came from the tap or from the record.

messages.ar: كلمة واحدة قصيرة، من غير أرقام ولا رموز غريبة.
messages.en: One short word, with no digits and no odd marks in it.
messages.desc: The addressing word a family typed was refused.

messages.en: The app would not take that change.
messages.desc: A refusal with no reason this build can name — said plainly, never dressed up.
